notes.title: GameUpdate
notes.content:
Reworked the shield mechanism, replacing the previous collision slow-down.

Now, colliding while sprinting will consume shields.
After a period of time, the shields will automatically regenerate.
Bursts and dashes will also regenerate shields, with dashes regenerating two layers and bursts regenerating 1-3 layers depending on the energy consumed.
When there are no shields, subsequent collisions will reduce health.

Modified all upgrades and items related to the shield.

Reworked the effects for upgrades and taking damage.
Added new effects for revival and death.

Added two new upgrades:

Rock Rolling Sands:
Shoot out shattered rocks to knock enemies away while sprinting.

Earthshaking Five Peaks (an advanced version of "Heavier than Mount Tai"):
A new mechanism, only available after unlocking all the previous upgrades in the upgrade tree.
Can be upgraded after obtaining all the "Heavier than Mount Tai" upgrades, vibrations will produce aftershocks.

Reworked two upgrades:

Soft Flow, Weak Water reworked into Winding Stream:
The character can now circle around a point.
"You can't stop... but you can turn around."

Stone Cracking Eggs:
Now entirely focused on enhancing knockback.

notes.title: UI Remake
notes.content:
After revamping the UI, there might be some issues with the English display. Once we've fixed the main bugs, we'll update the multi-language support.

[h1]RoadMap[/h1]

Upcoming updates will be posted on our main page. In short:

We'll focus on fixing existing bugs first. Also, we're working on improving elite monsters and some features in the game's encyclopedia, along with some minor tweaks.

Every week, we'll rework 1-2 characters and their corresponding upgrades.

Once the basic rework is done and the game is stable, we'll look into overhauling the foundation to completely address the lag issues.

[h1]Game Update[/h1]

Regarding gameplay, we've tweaked monster health. Difficulty has been ramped up to level 15, and most of the upgrades have been beefed up.

[h1]UI Remake[/h1]

We've redesigned all the UI, making everything look clearer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120222/c5ef1d20b10dd838108acaf08f40834ce47fb2cc.png[/img]

Now, you can adjust the difficulty in both character and map selection. When using a controller, pressing the A button will select and jump to the continue button.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120222/9dd577d49546303afebe936d3b590536276968fa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120222/1d21ae4c27e465f374e1f970147765084ddf891b.png[/img]

Once you've unlocked items and upgrade weights, you can tweak them in the item talent screen. Each character has their own settings. In the item bar, left-click to carry items and right-click to cancel. Unlocking talents lets you carry more. In the weight column, left-click to increase the appearance rate, right-click to decrease.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120222/5c4d756f96d943e59d89a1258af04d3b1fdad124.png[/img]

We've added a few different UI styles in the game interface. You can adjust your preferences in settings. We're really not sure which one's the best, so we'll tweak it based on your feedback.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120222/1d72325ba2ac660095dac446069dc553fae21131.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120222/bac8a597b52f30965b2851d987dde1741964468d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120222/1cedf0970339add1e21bd85164cd36afb89f7a0d.png[/img]

The pause menu is clearer now; you can see all upgrades at a glance.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44120222/09a9c3fd77d91123c2c3749d4e113cc336018c34.png[/img]

We'll also gradually add to the game's encyclopedia in the future.

Removed the previous limit of 9 maximum health points. Now, players can have unlimited maximum health points, but displaying too many may cause issues. To the Maitreya players who took advantage of this, I apologize for the oversight.

Spirit abilities no longer require points to unlock and are now placed in the first position. After internal discussions, it was unanimously agreed that Spirit abilities are more enjoyable and suitable for new players, hence the change.

notes.title: 7/21 Character Adjustments and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Overall Adjustments:

Reduced the cost to unlock characters and upgrade talents. 
(The intention behind unlocking and upgrading is to guide players to gradually familiarize themselves with the game, not to obstruct the normal gaming experience. If you still find it too expensive, feel free to provide feedback in the group, comments section, community, etc., and we'll further decrease the costs.)

Moved up the appearance time of Bosses.


Character Enhancements:

Significantly shortened the distance needed for General's trample to cause damage.

Lowered the energy required for Maitreya's burst ability.

Increased the probability of Maitreya's blessings in Blessing as Vast as the Sea 23.


Bug Fixes:

Resolved the bug where General's trample only inflicted damage on one enemy.

Fixed the bug where Maitreya's Tranquil Pool 4 had no delay.
